resources.string: FileRescue Libre needs root access to read the device storage directly and recover deleted files. Without root, Android\'s scoped storage restricts file access, making reliable recovery impossible.

FileRescue Libre scans the unallocated space of internal storage (a technique called "file carving") to recover deleted files. This requires direct access to the system\'s block device, which is only available on rooted devices (for example via Magisk). No data ever leaves your device: all processing stays local.
